nodes.title: 01  Audit & contract
nodes.subtitle: Provenance, coverage, reconciliation
nodes.description: Freeze the forecast contract and source hashes. Audit missingness, timestamps, country/regional reconciliation and the operational availability gate.

nodes.title: 02  Development EDA
nodes.subtitle: Calendar, temperature, RTE errors
nodes.description: Use development data to examine season, weekdays, holidays, temperature bands and delayed effects; record modeling hypotheses.

nodes.title: 03  Replay & baselines
nodes.subtitle: Origin → next-day intervals
nodes.description: Run integrity tests, reconstruct information available at each origin, save feature/label stores and replay four baseline policies.

nodes.title: 04  Model comparison
nodes.subtitle: Validate → select → freeze
nodes.description: Compare bounded feature/model ablations on chronological validation. Check guardrails and fallback stress tests. Freeze selection before test replay; keep oracle weather separate.

nodes.title: 05  Uncertainty & failures
nodes.subtitle: Frozen test, intervals, bootstrap
nodes.description: Replay the frozen candidate on the previously explored test. Score matched hours, calculate paired block uncertainty, evaluate intervals and inspect failures.

nodes.title: 06  Business & deployment
nodes.subtitle: Evidence, monitoring, risks
nodes.description: Answer the manager's three questions: improvement over RTE, uncertainty/failures, deployment/risks. Recommend prospective shadow evidence; do not equate forecast skill with euro savings.

nodes.title: Forecast contract
nodes.subtitle: 11:00 Paris · D−1 → next day
nodes.description: Defines cutoff, 23/24/25-hour delivery days, chronological splits, MAE objective, availability assumptions, guardrails and fallbacks. Sources.json records provided source identities.

nodes.title: Provided source data
nodes.subtitle: National + 12 regional CSVs
nodes.description: Original national demand/RTE/temperature and regional demand/temperature. Source-to-hourly conversion and original vintages are unverified. Values are preserved by the audit.

nodes.title: Evaluation lock
nodes.subtitle: Contract + source fingerprints
nodes.description: Notebook 01 records fingerprints. A changed contract or source identity requires an explicitly versioned new research run.

nodes.title: Frozen candidate
nodes.subtitle: Validation-selected RTE correction
nodes.description: Notebook 04 freezes the validation-selected experiment and contract identity; notebook 05 and 06 read it. The current selected model is RTE-assisted and retrospective.

nodes.title: Authentic vintage schemas
nodes.subtitle: Demand · RTE runs · weather runs
nodes.description: All three current CSVs contain headers only. Integration expects valid_time, available_at, forecast issued_at/run_id, numeric value and demand revision status. These are interfaces, not authentic historical runs.

nodes.title: Operational gate CLOSED
nodes.subtitle: Missing archives + unverified lineage
nodes.description: No authentic operational experiment is enabled. Availability gate requires nonempty valid archives, verified vintage provenance and verified interval aggregation. Current results support retrospective research and shadow design only.

nodes.title: data.py
nodes.subtitle: Audit + archive selection
nodes.description: Read inputs, preserve missing targets, reconcile complete regional populations, write audit artifacts, validate archive schemas and select an available forecast run.

nodes.title: eda.py
nodes.subtitle: Development frame + hypotheses
nodes.description: Restrict exploration to development periods; summarize temperature bands and generate a short hypothesis register. Future realized weather remains diagnostic.

nodes.title: features.py
nodes.subtitle: Cutoff features + fallback
nodes.description: Construct per-origin/per-delivery features using only cutoff-eligible history. Keep labels separate, support authentic archive snapshots and apply the declared fallback order.

nodes.title: backtest.py
nodes.subtitle: Fit, replay, freeze, archive
nodes.description: One replay engine serves baselines and learned models. Training labels must be available before fitting. Per-origin prediction ledgers close before the next fit; aggregate forecasts have immutable copies.

nodes.title: uncertainty.py
nodes.subtitle: Past-error + quantile evaluation
nodes.description: Rolling intervals from past out-of-sample errors, interval coverage/width/pinball metrics and complete residual-day trajectory scenarios. Calibration uses available outcomes only.

nodes.title: pipeline.py
nodes.subtitle: Readiness, monitoring, risks
nodes.description: Readiness checks and monitoring/risk specifications. It does not implement an external ingestion service, scheduler, publication endpoint or procurement decision.

nodes.title: common.py
nodes.subtitle: Calendar, DST, origins, hashes
nodes.description: Shared local calendar, French national holidays, UTC delivery grids across daylight saving, forecast origins, fingerprints and contract loading.

nodes.title: metrics.py
nodes.subtitle: Matched scores + block bootstrap
nodes.description: MAE/RMSE/bias/WAPE, availability, common eligible hours, segments, complete-day metrics and paired contiguous-day block resampling.

nodes.title: storage.py
nodes.subtitle: Restore typed saved artifacts
nodes.description: Read saved feature, evaluation-label and forecast tables with timestamp conversion. Stored targets remain separate from forecast archives.

nodes.title: Integrity tests
nodes.subtitle: 18 behavioral checks
nodes.description: Tests cover unavailable future information, label delays, forecast issuance/publication, DST, missingness, fallback, reproducibility and paired bootstrap eligibility. Test count is from the current test definitions; this graph build does not rerun models.

nodes.title: Notebook tooling
nodes.subtitle: Author → execute → validate
nodes.description: build_notebooks.py authors notebook cells; execute_notebooks.py runs them in order with a project-local kernel; validate_artifacts.py checks execution/artifact invariants and exports HTML/PNG previews. The graph build does not execute these scripts.

nodes.title: Audited data & register
nodes.subtitle: Dictionary, limitations, overlap
nodes.description: Audited hourly national grid includes regional reconciliation and temperature summaries. Audit reports record missingness, frequency, coverage, suspicious retained values and source limitations.

nodes.title: Hypothesis register
nodes.subtitle: Temperature bands + EDA evidence
nodes.description: Development findings become hypotheses for calendar, demand-history, temperature and RTE correction features. Observation counts remain visible for sparse bands.

nodes.title: Origin feature store
nodes.subtitle: Features and labels stored apart
nodes.description: Rows represent forecast origin plus delivery interval. Information availability and label availability are explicit; complete origin groups stay together.

nodes.title: Forecasts & fitted models
nodes.subtitle: Ledgers, immutable copies, fit logs
nodes.description: Per-origin append-only ledgers, aggregate forecasts and manifests, serialized pipelines and fit-origin logs provide the replay evidence trail. Forecast archives exclude evaluation outcomes.

nodes.title: Scores & uncertainty
nodes.subtitle: Segments, intervals, failures
nodes.description: Matched model/RTE scores, availability, temporal folds, critical segments, paired block intervals, coverage reports, daily scenarios and failure catalogue.

nodes.title: Manager recommendation
nodes.subtitle: Skill · uncertainty · deployment
nodes.description: Final report separates measured forecast losses, uncertainty and failure evidence, business proxies and deployment prerequisites. Current recommendation requires prospective shadow validation.
